name: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II)
key_finding: Flames in low-speed forced flow in microgravity survived down to unexpectedly low oxygen concentrations compared to normal gravity flammability limits.
verified_by: NASA Glenn Research Center / PSI Curated
notes: MSG glovebox investigations examining solid cylindrical and flat PMMA and cotton-fiberglass samples. Official DOI: 10.60555/4qc4-de67.

name: Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX)
key_finding: Confirmed existence of two-stage combustion and sustained quasi-steady low-temperature 'cool flames' in spherical droplets after hot flame extinction.
notes: Quiescent droplet burning with chamber pressure variation in CIR. Official DOI: 10.60555/mbq8-0451.

name: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments (ACME - CLD)
key_finding: Soot-free spherical and laminar diffusion flames mapped under varying oxygen enrichment and co-flow conditions.
notes: Co-flow laminar diffusion flames in CIR test chamber. Verified NASA ACME program.

name: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment (SPICE)
key_finding: Determined soot inception and smoke-point transitions in laminar co-flow microgravity flames, benchmarking spacecraft fire detection thresholds.
verified_by: NASA Glenn Research Center / MSG Science Team
notes: MSG glovebox investigations examining smoke point and soot production. Official DOI: 10.60555/mzjm-yv57.

name: Lunar-g Combustion / FM2 (Upcoming Surface Target)
key_finding: CONFIRMED GAP: Zero 0.16g empirical partial-gravity combustion data exist in the NASA PSI repository. High-priority mission requirement for lunar surface habitat qualification.
verified_by: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (Pending Flight Mission LUCI/FM2)
notes: CONFIRMED GAP: Zero 0.16g empirical data in NASA PSI repository. High-priority target for upcoming lunar surface missions.
